text:
Alice Nguyen: Hey folks — I opened PR #482 for console/observability: adds tracing hooks to the UI backend + a couple of dashboard metric tweaks. Can someone take a quick look when you have a sec? https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/482 :eyes:

Bob Patel: on it. is this touching any alerting thresholds or just instrumentation?

Alice Nguyen: Mainly instrumentation. Added span attrs: `user_id`, `route`, `cache_hit`. Also bumped the dashboard panel queries to surface `cache_hit` rate and a small summary counter. No alert thresholds changed, but Emily might want to check the new `cache_hit_ratio` metric name.

Carlos Romero: I can review ~ in an hour. Quick Q — I saw a failing test locally related to `trace-serializer.test` that popped up intermittently, is that flaky or part of this change?

Alice Nguyen: ugh yeah that one is flaky (race in test harness). I added a retry in the test to reduce flakes but left a TODO to replace with deterministic mock. Not part of behaviour change.

Emily Chen: tagging in case this touches SRE dashboards. The `cache_hit_ratio` metric name is fine but prefer `cache_hit_rate` to match other panels. Also: if we surface `user_id` as span attr we should strip PII — are we hashing or truncating?

Alice Nguyen: good catch. we hash `user_id` before adding to spans (sha1 short). I can rename `cache_hit_ratio` -> `cache_hit_rate` in the PR. That keeps consistency.

Carlos Romero: quick review done: left two tiny nits (naming + doc line). major flows look good. also please add a changelog snippet for the dashboard change.

Alice Nguyen: thanks @Carlos — pushing a commit in a sec.

CI Bot: CI pipeline started for commit a3f4b2d — running unit tests and e2e.

DeployBot: staging deployment queued after CI passes.

Bob Patel: glanced at the dashboard JSON — LGTM once the metric rename is in. Won't block merge. :thumbsup:

Alice Nguyen: pushed fix for metric name + changelog entry.

CI Bot: All checks passed for commit b7d9e1f.

Carlos Romero: approve — LGTM.

Alice Nguyen: thanks all. I'll merge after the 10m window to let any other feedback surface. planning to merge at ~1767124016 (in 10 min).

Bob Patel: sounds good.

Emily Chen: thanks — I'll watch the alerting dashboards for 1 hour after merge.

Alice Nguyen: merging now.

DeployBot: merged PR #482 into main by Alice Nguyen. Staging deploy started.

CI Bot: staging deploy succeeded.

Alice Nguyen: lovely — closing thread, will follow up if we see any regressions. :tada:
